## Professional Experience Summary
- **Fullstack Developer (AI & Core Systems)** at Entropy Systems (Apr 2024 - Present):
  Co-designed agentic system architecture and engineered core AI tooling backend (multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, autonomous execution loops) with <50ms M2M latency. Engineered distributed asynchronous report generation engine (Fastify, Python, BullMQ, Redis) reducing processing time by 65% (2,000+ monthly docs). Engineered secure event pipeline connecting isolated client VPCs with core (10,000+ daily events, zero public endpoint exposure). Standardized agent-assisted SDLC workflows (-62% refactoring lead time). 99.9% uptime on AWS/GCP with zero-downtime CI/CD.
- **Software & Mobile Engineer (Consultant · Side Project)** at Fintech Scale-up · NDA (Jul 2025 - Jul 2026):
  Delivered end-to-end cross-platform mobile architecture (iOS/Android) in React Native and TypeScript (20+ modular views, biometric KYC onboarding). Engineered cloud data infrastructure with Row-Level Security (RLS). Optimized cold-start times by 35% with offline persistence.
- **Fullstack Developer** at Interfell - ePayco (Jun 2021 - Apr 2024):
  Maintained 99.9% availability across mission-critical payment gateway microservices processing 500,000+ monthly transactions in Node.js (Express), TypeScript, and MySQL. Implemented financial idempotency and resilience via Circuit Breakers, Rate Limiting, and AWS SQS queues with DLQs. Reduced p95 transaction latency by 28%.
- **Systems Analyst / Software Developer** at Intelix Synergy, C.A. (Mar 2020 - Jun 2021):
  Engineered 3 modular internal management applications in JavaScript, Node.js, and Python. Maintained high availability on production Linux servers with NGINX. Standardized API contracts with OpenAPI/Swagger.
